cases.title: Each SDK reproduces the vector canonical bytes
cases.when: The tools in tool-01, tool-02 and tool-03 are authored in the SDK and packaged
then: The emitted descriptors equal the .jcs bytes exactly

cases.title: descriptorSetDigest matches the set vector
cases.when: The three tools are packaged together

cases.title: The closed rewrite set decides equivalence
cases.when: Each equivalence vector pair is compared
then: equiv-01 equivalent; equiv-02, -03 and -04 are changes, as expected.json says

cases.title: The descriptor digest excludes deployment and runtime values
cases.when: The same tool is packaged with different SDK version, runtime version, destination host, global values, secret sources and examples
then: toolDescriptorDigest is unchanged in every case

cases.title: Every semantic member changes the digest
cases.when: One member at a time is changed: title, description, schema, errors, effect, business-key settings, route template, declared global, secret, claim, execution setting, descriptorGeneration
then: Each change gives a different toolDescriptorDigest

cases.title: packageDigest is SHA-256 of the canonical CHECKSUMS bytes
cases.when: The valid package is digested, then signatures/ is added
then: Digest equals sha256 of CHECKSUMS.sha256, not of the zip
Adding signatures does not change it

cases.title: artifactDigest covers one artifact's exact bytes
cases.when: One byte of an artifact changes
then: artifactDigest and packageDigest change; toolDescriptorDigest does not

cases.title: Same inputs give identical bytes
cases.when: The same source is packaged twice with the same SDK, compiler, descriptorGeneration and build configuration, on two machines and two directories
then: Identical canonical descriptor bytes and identical packageDigest

cases.title: Minor and patch SDK upgrades keep descriptors equivalent
cases.when: The fixture project is packaged with every supported minor and patch of the current major at one generation
then: Descriptors are equivalent under the rewrite set, unless a listed correction applies

cases.title: Moving the generation pin gives a classified diff
cases.when: The fixture project moves descriptorGeneration from N-1 to N
then: The packager prints the expected semantic diff
Control classifies it as API change or security delta and starts that review path

cases.title: descriptorGeneration has no default
cases.when: A project omits the generation setting
then: The build fails naming the setting

cases.title: A mandatory security generation refuses the old pin after its date
cases.when: A build pins a generation marked mandatory-replaced, before and after the stated date
then: Before: warning; after: the build fails
